summary: C21 Investments Inc. filed a Form 6-K containing its interim condensed consolidated financial statements and MD&A for the quarter ended June 30, 2026, along with CEO and CFO certifications. The filing is routine quarterly disclosure by a foreign private issuer, showing no special-situation transaction. Financial highlights include revenue of $7.63 million, a net loss reflected in reduced equity, and ongoing liabilities such as convertible debentures and an uncertain tax position. No merger, acquisition, tender, or similar corporate event is announced. The filing is purely operational and financial reporting, with no strategic or transactional elements to analyze.
